Introduction
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide.
You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.
At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results.
Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
 Your Role And Responsibilities
 Design and develop advanced PostgreSQL database solutions supporting enterprise data platforms and migration initiatives.
Build and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and triggers to improve application performance and data reliability.
Collaborate with data engineers and application teams to execute Sybase-to-PostgreSQL migration activities, including transformation, validation, and testing.
Contribute to data architecture decisions, troubleshoot complex database issues, and ensure delivery quality across migration and database issues, and ensure delivery quality across migration and development streams.
 Preferred Education
 Bachelor's Degree
 Required Technical And Professional Expertise
Advanced PostgreSQL development with SQL, functions, and triggers
Strong stored procedure design and query performance optimization
Sybase to SQL migration and data transformation expertise
Data validation, reconciliation, and migration testing experience
Fluent French and English communication for technical collaboration
 Preferred Technical And Professional Experience
PostgreSQL indexing, partitioning, and execution plan analysis
ETL development and data pipeline troubleshooting
Shell scripting or Python for migration automation
Git, CI/CD pipelines, and release management practices
Familiarity with Agile delivery and enterprise data platforms
